delivered_files.role: Managed background server lifecycle with authenticated health probes, PID ownership checks and bounded shutdown.
Private atomic lifecycle state and log location under ARKA_NORN_HOME.
Public start, status, restart, stop and foreground commands with localized human and stable JSON output.
Authenticated loopback health endpoint used to verify process ownership before signalling.
Real detached lifecycle coverage including PID and token rotation.
Private state validation, permissions and ownership coverage.
Current Web lifecycle quick start and npm script reference.
Complete lifecycle, security, state, log and token rotation documentation.
Canonical CLI command surface for the managed Web server.

covered_requirements.requirement: Users can start, inspect, restart and stop the local Web server without managing a foreground terminal.
covered_requirements.evidence: The lifecycle E2E verifies start, authenticated health, status, restart with PID and token rotation, stop and idempotent stop.

covered_requirements.requirement: Lifecycle control never signals an unverified process and keeps state, logs and tokens private.
covered_requirements.evidence: The manager probes the token-protected loopback health endpoint before SIGTERM; state and logs are mode 0600 and state removal is PID-owned.

covered_requirements.requirement: README and user, Agent, developer, CLI, security, architecture, release and troubleshooting guides document the shipped Web behavior.
covered_requirements.evidence: The documentation and package manifest expose the same five public lifecycle actions and the four npm aliases.

covered_requirements.requirement: The managed server ships in the 2.1.0 package and preserves all quality gates.
covered_requirements.evidence: 253 full tests, 112 unit tests, CLI coverage at 77.00% lines and 73.48% functions, isolated tarball installation, benchmark, dependency audit and npm pack dry-run pass.
